asks: Asks that Brooks be taken out of Brooks-Medicine Hat and joined north-south with the County of Newell, the MD of Taber and Taber (or failing that, return to the pre-2017 arrangement).

note: Lethbridge named only as a shopping, sports and trade destination for Brooks residents; no request about the city's districts.

asks: Asks that Brooks be separated from Medicine Hat, with one mostly urban Medicine Hat riding and another joining part of the city to Cypress County, Forty Mile and Bow Island, and a more natural boundary inside the city.

note: Lethbridge named only as the direction of Brooks- and Taber-area agriculture; no request about the city's districts.

asks: Asks that Brooks get its own riding and Medicine Hat be split into two ridings (Medicine Hat-Cypress and Medicine Hat-Redcliff).
Endorses Bob Wanner's earlier proposal for Medicine Hat; no request of his own.

Asks that Brooks be moved out of Brooks-Medicine Hat back toward Strathmore and Chestermere, and that Forty Mile and Bow Island return to a Cypress-Medicine Hat riding, even if slightly below average population.

note: Chestermere named only as part of the area (Calgary, Strathmore, Chestermere) Brooks should rejoin; says nothing about whether Chestermere shares a district with Calgary.
Lethbridge named only as a river city where southeastern migration ends; no request about the city's districts.

asks: Asks that Medicine Hat be split into an almost all-urban Redcliff-Medicine Hat riding and a Medicine Hat-Dunmore (Cypress-Medicine Hat) riding with Cypress County.
Asks that the two Fort McMurray ridings be kept at the low end of the population range (toward minus 25 per cent) and that productivity, not only population, weigh in representation.
Asks that Fort McMurray keep two MLAs (not go back to one), using exemptions if needed, keep the rural-urban balance, and preferably split the ridings at the Athabasca River.

Asks that the commission weigh the vast geography of the two Fort McMurray ridings and, if the Athabasca River became the dividing line, push Fort McMurray-Lac La Biche further south toward Cold Lake; prefers minor course corrections.
Asks that the Peace River riding not be made any bigger; if it must grow, add Berwyn and the rest of the MD of Peace rather than lands to the east.

note: Lesser Slave Lake named only as a neighbouring riding whose High Prairie constituents sometimes come to the Peace River office, and for its single office in Slave Lake; no request about the riding.

asks: Asks that the Peace River riding not be enlarged and that the KTC First Nations not be added to it, because the MLA could not serve them.

Asks that Woodland Cree and Lubicon (and if possible the other KTC First Nations) be moved from Lesser Slave Lake into the Peace River riding, since Peace River is their service centre and Slave Lake is too far.

note: Asks to move Woodland Cree and Lubicon (possibly all five KTC nations) out of Lesser Slave Lake into Peace River: 'include the five nations, like was mentioned, because we’re actually all part of Lesser Slave Lake, just over.' A boundary transfer that says nothing about keeping or dissolving the riding, so no K option is coded (rule 17).

asks: Asks that the Peace River riding not be made geographically bigger; after first allowing it, she withdraws support for adding the Woodland Cree and other First Nations to it.

note: Lesser Slave Lake named only to say Scott Sinclair is its MLA and part of Northern Sunrise County lies in it; no request about the riding.

asks: Asks that the Peace River riding not take on more area and that northern geography and resource corridors be weighed, not population alone.
